query:
SELECT
            p.id,
            p.slug AS "slug!",
            p.title AS "title!",
            p.description,
            p.tags AS "tags!",
            p.category,
            p.type_id,
            pt.name AS "type_name!",
            p.created_at AS "created_at!",
            p.updated_at AS "updated_at!",
            production.version AS "production_version?",
            production.created_at AS "production_version_created_at?"
         FROM prompts p
         INNER JOIN prompt_types pt ON pt.id = p.type_id
         LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
             SELECT
                pv.version,
                pv.created_at
             FROM prompt_versions pv
             WHERE pv.prompt_id = p.id
               AND pv.stage = 'PRODUCTION'::prompt_stage
             ORDER BY pv.version DESC
             LIMIT 1
         ) AS production ON TRUE
         WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR p.slug ILIKE ('%' || $1 || '%') OR p.title ILIKE ('%' || $1 || '%'))
           AND ($2::text IS NULL OR p.slug LIKE ($2 || '%'))
           AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR p.type_id = $3)
           AND ($4::text IS NULL OR p.category = $4)
           AND ($5::text IS NULL OR $5 = ANY(p.tags))
         ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC
         LIMIT $6
         OFFSET $7
